issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect assembleBookstore to return a Bookstore, but the solution's implementation declares assembleBookstore with return type Void while returning a Bookstore. This return-type mismatch will not compile and contradicts the intended API students are meant to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution's assembleBookstore signature to return a Bookstore (private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore) so it matches the problem statement and the template. Ensure the implementation returns the constructed Bookstore (instead of declaring -> Void).
